faq-section-desc: Direct clarity regarding sprint timelines, code ownership, and continuous integration models.
faq-1-question: What is your typical project delivery timeline?
faq-1-answer: Standard MVP deliveries typically range between 3 to 6 weeks depending on architectural complexity, third-party integrations, and API surfaces. Enterprise contracts and retainer platforms run on agile 2-week continuous release sprints.
faq-2-question: Do you work with early-stage startups or enterprise companies?
faq-2-answer: Both. For early-stage startups, I operate as a Fractional Tech Lead / Founding Engineer to translate vision into hardened code rapidly. For established engineering teams, I join to solve critical performance bottlenecks or scale microservices.
faq-3-question: How do you handle asynchronous communication and timezone differences?
faq-3-answer: I prioritize asynchronous clarity using Loom video demos, Linear issue tracking, PR reviews with detailed architectural diagrams, and shared Slack/Discord channels with an active overlap window across UTC+2 to UTC-5.
faq-4-question: What guarantees and post-launch maintenance do you offer?
faq-4-answer: Every deployment includes a 30-day post-launch warranty covering bug fixes, latency audits, and automated zero-downtime monitoring setup. Extended SLA retainer packages are also available.
